asset.name: PlanView
asset.description: The structured plan showing goals, steps, dependencies, status, revisions, blockers, and user-editable checkpoints, with plain-language explanation of why a step is blocked.

requires.reason: Hierarchy, expansion, and keyboard traversal are shared.
Certainty and urgency are expressed on the shared orthogonal axes rather than as one flat variant set.

suggests.reason: Dependency-heavy plans benefit from a graph view; linear plans do not.
